author: Marcus R. Brown
description:
## What

Removes a site-wide `<link rel="preload">` for `/fonts/system-ui.woff2` from `docs/astro.config.mjs`.

## Why

`system-ui` is the native OS font-family keyword (already used in `docs/src/styles/sparkle-theme.css` — `--sparkle-font-family-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", ...`), not a downloadable web font. No file was ever added under `docs/public/fonts/`, so this preload has 404'd on every single page load since it was introduced in #911 (2025-09-11).

Found during the daily autohealing live docs-site-health check (`https://sparkle.mrbro.dev`) via `agent-browser network requests`:

```
GET https://sparkle.mrbro.dev/fonts/system-ui.woff2 (Font) 404
```

Reported as a minor finding in the last two daily autohealing updates without a fix; since the root cause and fix are unambiguous and minimal (delete an 11-line dead config block), fixing directly here.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @sparkle/docs build` — succeeds, 71 pages built, `dist/` no longer references `system-ui.woff2`
- `pnpm check` — clean
- `pnpm fix` — no additional changes needed
